Detailed Description

the parts of an icon-list specific to the evas canvas.

generic parts are in icon_list. gevas-specific parts are in gevas_bind.

void evas_icon_set_state (  icon_list *  il,
icon *  i,
icon_state  s
) 
 

set state (selected, normal, .

..) of an icon. if the icon-factory provides a function icon_set_state(), that function will be called. if it returns TRUE (or there is no such function), all elements suitable for the desired state will be shown; all others will be hidden.

Parameters:
il - the icon-list
i - the icon
s - the desired state

icon *  i,
int  x,
int  y
)  [inline]
 

check whether mouse-pointer is over a given icon.

this means "within the icon's bounding box, within an element's bounding box, on a non-transparent pixel". called from icon_list::icon_list_get_icon_at().

Parameters:

i - the icon
x - mouse-x, window-relative
y - mouse-y, window-relative
